runA.DetectDescription: Instruction-like content arrived via an untrusted tool output / retrieved document.

CaseCard.Narrative: [request-side · alert_only] Instruction originated in user turn #0 embedded "INDEXED DOCUMENT" block (untrusted) → influenced tool call submit_to_index(call_1791828718069_x1bnj4) → toward 127.0.0.1 (http) → reported (alert-only) by rule inbound.exfil_instruction.
